title: Recourse for Defects in BTO HDB Flats
what_it_is: Recourse for Defects in BTO HDB Flats

sections.label: Defects Liability Period and BSC
sections.summary: A one-year Defects Liability Period starts after keys are handed over, with a Building Service Centre set up in each new precinct.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: After the keys are handed over, a one-year Defects Liability Period (DLP) will kick in.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: During the DLP, a Building Service Centre (BSC) is set up in every new precinct to attend to feedback from residents promptly.

sections.label: HDB help for unsatisfied owners
sections.summary: Owners not fully satisfied with rectification works can approach HDB, which will look into each case and address concerns.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For cases where owners are not fully satisfied with the rectification works, they can approach HDB, who will look into very case and take all reasonable efforts to address the owner's concerns.

sections.label: BTO flat quality scores
sections.summary: The quality of BTO flats improved from a score of 79 in 2003 to 89 in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Over the years, the quality of BTO flats has improved from a score of 79 in 2003 to 89 in 2014.

sections.label: Defects rectified within 14 days
sections.summary: About 95% of defects reported through Building Service Centres are rectified within 14 days.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Based on the statistics that we have, some 95% of these defects reported through BSCs are rectified within 14 days.

sections.label: HDB increases BSC staffing
sections.summary: HDB has increased the number of staffing at Building Service Centres to deal with issues surfaced by residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Already, HDB has increased the number of staffing at BSCs to deal with the issues that are surfaced by residents.
